U.A. Academy.text: Japan's national hero academy: a three-year residential program for high-school graduates, who all live in the Heights Alliance dorms on its walled campus above Musutafu. Principal Nezu, a white-furred animal with a genius intellect, runs it, and its teachers are working pro heroes: Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head), Present Mic, Nemuri Kayama, Cementoss, Ectoplasm, Thirteen, Power Loader, Recovery Girl and, from this April, All Might. It has four courses: Hero, General Studies, Support and Management. The Hero Course takes only two classes a year; at the televised Sports Festival, agencies scout students and General Studies students can earn a transfer. Outsiders see the country's best hero academy. The visible contradiction: the academy that trains the public's protectors locks the public out.
